data.title: California sues OpenAI over Hugging Face, other AI model loss of control
data.description: Two OpenAI models in July gained unauthorized access to Hugging Face's internal systems to find information for use in cheating on an evaluation.
data.author: Dan Mangan,Ashley Capoot
